2609.09595.title: Teacher Geometry Shapes Learnability in Teacher-Student Networks
2609.09595.paper_summary: Teacher-student systems, in which a teacher neural network generates training labels so that a student neural network can learn to implement the same function, are widely used as an abstract setting to study learning. However, the structure of the teachers is often overlooked by assuming randomly-generated, normally-distributed parameters. This hides substantial variation in how learnable different teachers are. We formalize learnability as the success rate of converging to the global minimum, as a function of overparameterization, learning algorithm, student initialization distribution, and teacher geometry. We both identify an easy distribution that maximizes node dissimilarity and a hard distribution that minimizes it, and show that these two distributions induce markedly different success rates across a large range of settings and for different activation functions. To explain the gap, we study the loss landscape of small neural networks that contain two distinct kinds of suboptimal local minima, out-of-bounds (OOB) minima at the edge of the data distribution and interior minima within. Assuming infinite data and a fast readout layer, we analytically reduce the loss landscape of small networks to two dimensions, showing that the region of attraction of interior minima changes as a function of teacher structure. In larger networks, maximally dissimilar teachers induce more interior minima, while minimally dissimilar teachers induce more OOB minima. Motivated by these analyses, we show that differentially increasing the learning rate of the readout layer and decreasing the learning rate of the inner biases increases success rates. These findings provide an important step in narrowing the gap between the study of teacher-student networks and more structured functions that arise in practice.
2609.09595.paper_summary_zh: 教師-學生系統中，教師神經網絡生成訓練標籤，以便學生神經網絡學習實現相同的功能，這種系統被廣泛用作研究學習的抽象設置。<lb/>然而，教師的結構常常被忽視，假設隨機生成的、正態分佈的參數。<lb/>這隱藏了不同教師可學習性方面的實質變化。<lb/>我們將可學習性形式化為收斂到全局最小值的成功率，作為過參數化、學習算法、學生初始化分佈和教師幾何結構的函數。<lb/>我們既識別出一種最大化節點不相似性的簡單分佈，也識別出一種最小化節點不相似性的困難分佈，並顯示這兩種分佈在大量設置和不同激活函數下產生顯著不同的成功率。<lb/>為了解釋這一差距，我們研究了包含兩種不同類型的次優局部最小值的小型神經網絡的損失景觀，這些最小值分別是數據分佈邊緣的越界（OOB）最小值和內部最小值。<lb/>假設有無限數據和快速讀出層，我們在分析上將小型網絡的損失景觀降至兩個維度，顯示內部最小值的吸引區域隨著教師結構的變化而變化。<lb/>在較大的網絡中，最大不相似的教師會引入更多的內部最小值，而最小不相似的教師則會引入更多的OOB最小值。<lb/>受到這些分析的啟發，我們顯示差異性地增加讀出層的學習率並減少內部偏置的學習率會提高成功率。<lb/>這些發現為縮小教師-學生網絡研究與實踐中出現的更結構化函數之間的差距提供了一個重要的步驟。
